notes.title: Update Notice-0620
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! The development team of [i]The Apartment[/i] here with a greeting.[/p][p]This is our first update since the official release. We truly appreciate your tremendous support for cellveillance – we're working diligently![/p][p][b]Version Number:[/b] 0.0.5
[b]Update Contents:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Xu Huiyun's maximum affection level has been increased to 9; reaching level 9 unlocks the "Max Affection" achievement.[/p][/*][*][p]Prompt modifications:
a. Added investigation prompt for Wang Shicheng's home: [i]"If both conditions are not met simultaneously, this triggers the 'Junk Collector' storyline."[/i]
b. Changed "sell hallucinogens to Little Li" to "sell to Wang Shicheng".
c. Moved "Grandma Yu's death/survival" from Day 4 to Day 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievement prompt adjustments:
a. Complete Lin Tong's ending with max affection level
b. Complete Xu Huiyun's ending with max affection level
c. Complete Zhang Xiaoyu's ending with max affection level
d. Complete Xu Linqing's ending with max affection level
e. Complete Zhu Shaman's ending with max affection level[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes:
a. Fixed typos: "高利贷" (usury), "小暄" (Xiaoxuan), "身体撕碎" (body torn apart), "受害者" (victim).
b. Optimized email and Wang Shicheng's computer UI for ultrawide resolutions (3840×1080; 2048×1536).
c. Adjusted point value of Fomu Card/Little Li Card to 5 points.
d. Fixed erroneous "All Achievements Unlocked" trigger when choosing "feed Monkey #25" ending.
e. [p]Hello everyone! The development team of [i]The Apartment[/i] here with a greeting.[/p][p]This is our first update since the official release. We truly appreciate your tremendous support for cellveillance – we're working diligently![/p][p][b]Version Number:[/b] 0.0.4
[b]Update Contents:[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Updated Xu Linqing's Max Affection:[/b] Increased to 9. Reaching Affection Level 9 now unlocks the "Max Affection" achievement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Hint:[/b] Deleted the hint for the "Her Secret Room" plot point appearing after choosing the "Power of Gold Coins" plot branch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]a. Fixed an issue preventing the "No Money, But I Have My Life" achievement from unlocking.[/p][/*][*][p]c. Fixed an issue where concurrent line failures sometimes occurred without any prompt in specific situations.[/p][/*][*][p]d. Fixed an issue where selling hallucinogens to Wang Shicheng wouldn't increase money.[/p][/*][*][p]e. Fixed an issue where choosing to save Lin Tong with gold coins would skip the "Death Banana Peel" plot point.[/p][/*][*][p]f. Fixed an issue where Lin Tong's affection points were incorrectly allocated by 1 extra point.[/p][/*][*][p]g. Fixed an occasional bug in the Windows Steam release where user chat avatars appeared identical during the phone event in the "Justifiable Defense" plot point.[/p][/*][*][p]h. Fixed typos: "露陷" (should be 露馅, meaning "exposed") and "凡是要辩证地看待" (should be 凡事要辩证地看待, meaning "Everything should be viewed dialectically").[/p][/*][*][p]i.
